cand.title: CGA Energy Week 2026
cand.excerpt: Four-day energy-sector event at Westin Harbour Castle with a reserved hotel block for stays spanning October 25–29; the official page notes limited availability on one night and that part of the room rate supports the event, indicating real lodging and event revenue mechanics in the adjacent waterfront market.
cand.selectionWhy: Prior blocked-promising candidate (no exact date/contact in thin ledger)

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Commercial relationship candidates, not verified contract signatories: Tyson Soyka, President & CEO, Canavents; Tracy Collins, Chief Administrative Officer and Founder, Canavents; Meeta Singh, Director, Communications, CGA, also the named WiNG nominations contact; Emily Copp, Deputy Director, Communications, CGA, a secondary communications/advertising routing contact. Canavents is the published event-support route and lists Energy Week in its portfolio. Ask it to identify the actual accommodation/venue procurement lead; none of these sources proves individual hotel-contract authority.
findings.futureEdition: Official CGA post dated 2026-10-29 says: “Save the date: October 27, 2027” and “Calgary TELUS Convention Centre.” Next announced city: Calgary, Alberta, Canada, outside Toronto. Only this single activity date is published in the announcement; it does not establish the full start/end range or a one-day duration. No 2028 Energy Week announcement was found in the reviewed official sources. The June 17–18, 2027 WiNG module in Ottawa is a separate programme module, not another Energy Week edition.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specification: Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown could compete for a small delegate/speaker overflow block, executive lodging or limited side meetings on a future Toronto return, not exclusive housing or the full conference. CGA promoted “460+ delegates” before the 2026 event; this exceeds the supplied 240-theatre largest-room capacity and does not translate into a room count. A prospective 15–109 peak-room subset is a sales targeting range only, not published demand. This is an urban waterfront conference opportunity, not a resort programme. The 2027 Calgary edition creates no practical lodging opportunity for this Toronto hotel. Do not promise catering until the hotel’s restaurant/lounge and event-service capabilities are verified.
findings.venueCommitments: 2026: The Westin Harbour Castle, 1 Harbour Square, Toronto, Ontario, Canada; in Toronto proper on the downtown waterfront, not MTCC or Exhibition Place. Official event venue and CGA room block are published. 2027: Calgary TELUS Convention Centre, Calgary, Alberta, Canada, officially announced; not a hotel and outside this hotel’s territory. Public venue announcements establish venue selection, not access to signed contracts.
findings.historicalRotation: Published lineage: 2022 standalone Energy Nexus in Vancouver; first joint Energy Nexus & Annual Technical Conference in Calgary in April 2023; Toronto in October 2024; Calgary in October 2025; expanded Energy Week programme in Toronto in October 2026; Calgary save-the-date for October 27, 2027. The 2023–2027 city sequence alternates, but no formal rotation policy or Toronto 2028 commitment is established. Earlier standalone/joint editions are predecessors, not retrospectively renamed Energy Week.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2026 host-hotel block, not demonstrated open sourcing: “The Canadian Gas Association has reserved a block of rooms at The Westin Harbour Castle, Toronto for CGA Energy Week.” Discounted stays: October 25–29, 2026, distinct from October 26–29 activity dates. “A portion of your room rate will also go toward supporting the event.” The page says “limited accommodations remain for the night of October 28” and directs guests to book directly with the same Westin at market rates if the block is unavailable; those reservations are explicitly outside the CGA block. Every named hotel on the retrieved edition-specific housing page: The Westin Harbour Castle only. Although it refers to additional accommodation options, no second hotel is named in the retrieved text or links. Operational enquiry: help@canavents.com. No housing bureau or open hotel RFP was identified. 2027 hotel blocks, housing agent and sourcing stage remain unconfirmed.
findings.organizationStructure: Association-owned industry conference/training/exhibition programme, rather than a single-company incentive meeting. CGA describes itself as the voice of Canada’s natural gas delivery industry and says it organizes conferences and training. Energy Week combines Energy Nexus, Annual Technical Conference, Economic Regulation School, Gas Measurement & Regulation School and Women in Natural Gas. Canavents is an external event-management business and published support contact; Westin is the 2026 host venue/hotel, not the event owner. No evidence establishes a DMC or housing-bureau role.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Historical incumbent advantage: the 2026 Westin combined the meeting venue, official room block and an event-support contribution embedded in room rates. The October 28 availability warning is specific evidence of historical block pressure, not proof of a hotel-wide sellout, displaced guests, quantified overflow or an available Radisson block. The published fallback was direct booking at the Westin. No other committed overflow hotel, room pickup, peak-room figure or room-night total was found.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Treat as relationship development, not a live group RFP. Contact Canavents through help@canavents.com, addressing Tyson Soyka or asking for its Energy Week accommodation lead; use Meeta Singh at CGA as an owner-side introduction if needed. Request the 2026 accommodation debrief (October 28 unmet demand, block pickup and peak rooms), the next Toronto decision timetable, the approved-hotel/overflow selection process and any room-rate event-support requirements. Offer a conditional small-block/executive-lodging discussion for a future Toronto return only; do not quote rooms against Calgary 2027 or assume Toronto 2028.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2026 activity ended October 29, before the November 15 assessment and the December 6 horizon start: no remaining 2026 room-sale opportunity. Next announced edition is in Calgary, not Toronto; its housing status is unconfirmed, not open. Do not publish this as a confirmed upcoming Toronto lead.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: cultivate the owner and event-management partner for a future Toronto cycle, asking about an approved secondary block, speakers/VIPs and smaller associated groups. Historical alternation provides a reason to ask about a return, not evidence of Toronto 2028 dates or an open bid. No Toronto Energy Week demand is confirmed within the requested horizon; an autumn 2028 return, even if eventually announced, would fall after June 2028.
